one_sentence_story: By scanning volunteers solving Switch vs Footbridge moral dilemmas in 2001, Joshua Greene showed human morality is a dual-process tug-of-war between a fast ventromedial emotional alarm against personal force and a slower dorsolateral prefrontal cost-benefit calculator.
so_what_for_you: When facing high-stakes life or policy trade-offs, separate your automatic gut alarm ('does this feel personally violent?') from transparent outcome math ('how many people are helped or harmed overall?') so neither camera blinds the other.
